shortDescription: Obtain information about one or many QRadar Offenses, with filter options

options.name: assigned_to
options.description: Obtain only information of Offenses assigned to a certain user

options.name: closing_reason
options.description: Obtain only information of Offenses that were closed by a specific closing reason

options.name: closing_reason_id
options.description: Obtain only information of Offenses that were closed by a specific closing reason ID

options.name: follow_up
options.description: Obtain only information of Offenses that are marked with the follow up flag

options.name: id
options.description: Obtain only information of the Offense with provided ID

options.name: name
options.description: Obtain only information of the Offense that matches the provided name

options.name: protected
options.description: Obtain only information of Offenses that are protected

options.name: status
options.description: Obtain only information of Offenses of a certain status
